about: Every number the RSNA AI manuscript quotes, keyed to the JSON it was read from. tools/claims_check.py re-reads each one and fails on drift. Add a claim BEFORE quoting it; never edit `expect` to match a moved value without a dated note in `history`.

2026-09-22 13:25 EDT: REMOVED the lstv_* claims from story_rows_f2 (job 40414332): its card arms styled frames from the merged density path with a zero bone path, and the frames showed no spine. Re-derived from story_rows_f3 (job 40414408, water + bone paths with the cards' own definitions) once it finishes.

2026-09-22 13:35 EDT: clean-frame confirmation at L6 from story_rows_f3 (job 40414408): 45 of 54 chains exact, L6 named in 36. The card arms of the same job are still not usable: their frames are photon-starved (28-38 cm lateral water path) and show no spine.

2026-09-22 14:25 EDT: film-noise arm of the L6 confirmation (job 40414514): 45 of 54 chains exact, L6 named in 35 (clean control 45 / 36). Figure 1 row (f) is the run with the largest match margin among the correct ones (0.37).

2026-09-22 14:50 EDT: corpus manifold over 37 corpora (job 40414544/45). C-arms are separated pairwise (Bhattacharyya 0.005 to 0.675), but film vs fluoroscopy does NOT transfer to an unseen corpus: leave-one-corpus-out 71.1 % against a 71.8 % majority share. What the statistics separate is the corpus, not the domain.
